data.name: Nauru
data.summary: Nauru has no general personal income tax. Employment and Services Tax applies to wages and service fees, and Business Tax (20% for individuals) applies to persons conducting a business; since 1 January 2021 resident businesses are taxed on worldwide income. Whether a resident family managing its own portfolio is 'conducting a business' (defined as any activity for economic gain) is unclear, so gains and foreign dividends are left unknown. Dividends from Nauru companies are excluded. No inheritance, gift or wealth tax was found. Nauru sells citizenship from USD 90,000 (offer to 31 December 2026).

regimes.name: Ordinary residence
regimes.description: No general income tax; Business Tax on business income (worldwide for residents since 2021); Employment and Services Tax on wages/fees.
regimes.eligibility: Resident individual as defined in ESTA s. 7 and BTA s. 8 (not read in detail).

capital_gains.summary: No capital gains tax as such. Business profits tax applies to gross revenue from conducting a business, including 'a gain on disposal of a business asset' (BTA s. 17(1)(b)); since 1 January 2021 residents are taxed on worldwide amounts (s. 17(2A)). 'Business' means 'any activity, whether continuous or short term, conducted for the purposes of economic gain, other than an employment' (s. 3), which could arguably cover managing a large portfolio. Rates left unknown.

open_questions: Ask the NRO whether a resident individual's passive portfolio (foreign listed shares) is a 'business' under BTA s. 3; the NRO 'Guide to Completing Schedule 1 - Foreign Income' was not read.
capital_gains.rate_basis: If portfolio management is a business: gains on business assets at 20% (individual BPT rate; NRO). If not: 0. Not resolved, so null.
capital_gains.professional_trader: The broad statutory definition of 'business' is the issue: any activity for economic gain.

dividends.summary: Distributions by a resident company, partnership or trust are excluded from gross revenue (BTA s. 17(2)(a)). Foreign dividends are taxed only if they are proceeds of a business (worldwide basis since 2021, with a foreign tax credit); whether a passive investor is in business is unresolved, so the foreign rate is left unknown.
dividends.exemptions_thresholds: Individuals' business profits tax 20%; Nauruan residents have a AUD 250,000 tax-free threshold (NRO).

wealth_tax.summary: No net wealth tax: the NRO administers only the Revenue Administration Act, Employment and Services Tax Act, Business Tax Act, Telecommunications Service Tax Act and Gaming Act.

routes.name: Naoero Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Program
routes.requirements: Contribution USD 90,000 for a principal applicant under a limited-time offer to 31 December 2026 (USD 25,000 discount), USD 2,000 per additional dependant aged 16+, USD 15,000 per sibling; plus application fees (USD 5,000 + 2,000 per dependant), due diligence (USD 6,000 + 3,000 per dependant 16+), bank fees and USD 500 per passport. No residence requirement; dual citizenship allowed. Citizenship does not create tax residence.

data.us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain subject to US federal income, estate and gift tax on worldwide income and assets wherever they live; the app adds the federal layer. Where local tax on portfolio income is nil there is nothing to credit against US tax.
